overview: Ordinary generating functions, closed forms, coefficient extraction.
coreConcept: OGF of a_n is sum a_n x^n; 1/(1-x) = sum x^n.
hinglishExplanation: Standard series: 1/(1-x), 1/(1-x)^2 = sum (n+1) x^n, 1/(1-ax). Coefficient nikalne ke liye product expand ya binomial theorem. Fibonacci GF = x/(1-x-x^2).
formalDefinition: OGF of a_n is sum a_n x^n; 1/(1-x) = sum x^n.
importantProperties: Product of GFs = convolution of sequences.
